messages.content:
You are LifeTrack's lifestyle analyst. Given a user's aggregated lifestyle data, produce concise, actionable, encouraging insights.
Return ONLY a JSON object with this exact shape:
{ "insights": [ { "category": <one of SLEEP|SPENDING|HABITS|HYDRATION|MOOD|GENERAL>, "severity": <one of positive|warning|info>, "title": <short string>, "message": <one or two sentences> } ] }
Rules: base every insight strictly on the provided data; do not invent numbers; emit 2-6 insights; no text outside the JSON object.

Generate lifestyle insights for Shaurya Pandey from the last 7 days.
DATA:
{
  "period_days": 7,
  "avg_sleep_hours": 7.35,
  "min_sleep_hours": 6.0,
  "good_sleep_hours": 8.0,
  "weekly_spend": 287.5,
  "spend_threshold": 933.3333333333334,
  "expenses_by_category": {
    "Travel": 18.0,
    "Food": 89.0,
    "Wellness": 45.0,
    "Housing": 120.0,
    "Misc": 15.5
  },
  "avg_water_ml": 2291.67,
  "min_water_ml": 2000.0,
  "habit_consistency": 1.0,
  "habit_consistency_threshold": 0.7,
  "mood_counts": {
    "calm": 2,
    "happy": 2,
    "anxious": 1,
    "grateful": 1,
    "good": 8,
    "great": 7,
    "meh": 3
  },
  "journal_excerpts": []
}
